hooks.command:
# NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5 AC-6 (Least Privilege), CM-7 (Least Functionality),
# AC-3 (Access Enforcement). CISA Secure by Design: secure defaults.
#
# Resolve the data directory, quoting every expansion so a path containing
# spaces cannot word-split (CWE-78 defence in depth).
UA_DIR=.understand-anything; [ -d "$UA_DIR" ] || UA_DIR=.ua;
#
# REPO-CONTROLLED TRIGGER GUARD (do not remove).
# Every precondition below is a FILE INSIDE THE ANALYZED REPOSITORY. Without
# this guard a hostile repo could ship .ua/{config.json,meta.json,
# knowledge-graph.json} and cause an autonomous, tool-holding agent pipeline
# to start the moment a user opens the checkout -- no prompt, no consent.
# The data directory is local analysis state and must never be committed, so
# a git-TRACKED config.json means it came from the repository rather than
# from this user. Refuse to act on it.
if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$UA_DIR/config.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
#
# Read the PostToolUse payload from stdin and pull out the command that ran.
INPUT=$(cat);
CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input?.command||'')}catch{}})" 2>/dev/null);
printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+(commit|merge|cherry-pick|rebase)' \
  && [ -f "$UA_DIR/config.json" ] \
  && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' "$UA_DIR/config.json" \
  && [ -f "$UA_DIR/knowledge-graph.json" ] \
  && echo "[understand-anything] Commit detected with auto-update enabled. An incremental graph update is available. If the user wants it, read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md and follow it. Do NOT start the update on your own initiative -- mention that it is available and let the user decide." \
  || true

UA_DIR=.understand-anything; [ -d "$UA_DIR" ] || UA_DIR=.ua;
#

# this guard a hostile repo could ship .ua/{config.json,meta.json,
# knowledge-graph.json} and cause an autonomous, tool-holding agent pipeline

if git ls-files --error-unmatch "$UA_DIR/config.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
#
# Only offer when the user's own config opts in AND the graph is behind HEAD.
[ -f "$UA_DIR/config.json" ] \
  && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' "$UA_DIR/config.json" \
  && [ -f "$UA_DIR/meta.json" ] \
  && [ -f "$UA_DIR/knowledge-graph.json" ] \
  && [ "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$UA_DIR/meta.json','utf8')).gitCommitHash" 2>/dev/null)" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ] \
  && echo "[understand-anything] Knowledge graph is stale. An incremental graph update is available. If the user wants it, read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md and follow it. Do NOT start the update on your own initiative -- mention that it is available and let the user decide." \
  || true
